patches.value: For a smooth real mean-zero exact KdV solution u on [0,T], twist v=S_(-t)u, and smooth Scheme trajectory f_n=S_(-t_n)U^n, suppose M>=1+sup_[0,T]||v||_(H^gamma), 0<tau<=1, delta_n=||f_n-v(t_n)||_2<=1 and q_n=tau^gamma+delta_n. Then, Interp satisfies sup_(I_n)||rho_n||_2<=C_M*tau*q_n and ||mathcalR'||_(L^infty(I_n;H^(-pstar)))<=C_M*q_n. On any I=[a,b] contained in [0,T] with a a grid point, h=b-a<=1, define e=v-V and E_I=sup_I||e||_2. If E_I<=1 then sup_I||mathcalR(t)-mathcalR(a)||_2<=C_M*(h+tau)*(tau^gamma+E_I), ||e||_(X(I))<=C_M*(tau^gamma+E_I), and ||v||_(X(I))+||V||_(X(I))<=C_M. Intervals may end inside a step; derivative assertions hold a.e.

For a smooth real mean-zero exact KdV solution u on [0,T], twisted path v=S_(-t)u, and the Interp path V of the smooth twisted Scheme trajectory, M>=1+sup||v||_(H^gamma), 0<tau<=1, every grid-start interval I=[a,b] of length h<=1 with E_I=sup_I||v-V||_2<=1 and every real N>=2 satisfy E_I<=||e(a)||_2+C_M*(h+tau)*tau^gamma+C_M*(N^2*h+h+tau+N^(-1)+N^(-pstar))*E_I, where e=v-V. The constant depends only on M,gamma,T, not a,b,N,tau,support, and the interval may end inside a step. Both normal-form endpoints are retained.
